note: One baked take in FBX/GLB (master timeline). Unity: split into clips by these frame ranges; loop=true clips are seamless.

clips.name: Idle
clips.desc: standby: petals closed, crystal turns 60 deg (6-fold, seamless)

clips.name: Charge
clips.desc: charge: petals open to 22 deg, crystal rises 50 mm spinning up, glow grows

clips.name: Activate
clips.desc: activation: flash + phase ring expands, petals kick to 30 deg and settle

clips.name: Recover
clips.desc: recover: petals close, crystal lowers and coasts to 480 deg (= rest, 6-fold)

gameplay: Animation is visual only: it adds no gameplay capability, shot count or timing authority.
